evidence_kind: production parser/serializer synthetic DTO through actual Driver/Service/MCP; no live engine invocation
capability: Prepare and observe the current player's holy-site creation window; never create a holy site

wire.subject_id: query/open/type use 0; barony/artifact use full uint32 reference below sentinel 0xFFFFFFFF
wire.type_key: 1..160 exact UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; only the type selector accepts it
wire.selected: actual explicit bool, false preserved; only artifact selector accepts it
wire.request_id: step-{sequence}-{uuid.hex[:12]}; hello consumes sequence 1 in these fresh-driver fixtures
wire.revisions: caller uses actual public revision; Driver binds actual native revision separately

planner_sequence: 先获取当前公共快照和玩家身份；每次调用携带该快照的 expected_revision，不把 native_revision 当公共 revision。
只读查询取得 complete 候选模型。若模型未知、玩家信仰不匹配或原生不可用，保留诊断，不用空列表代替未知。
打开当前信仰创建窗口；从原生返回候选选择 type_key 和 barony_title_id。每次操作后读回独立选中状态，再规划下一项。
逐项设置圣物 selected=true/false；使用完整 artifact_id。已选中时允许 already_selected_verified，不需要重复切换。
准备完成后重新观察选中类型、男爵领、圣物及原生 tooltip。缓存成本没有新鲜度证明；缺失合法性、资源可负担性、渲染可见性都保持 unknown。
此接口以 create_dispatched=false 和核心 action_ready=false 结束；创建仍是未开放能力，不能把选择完成记为圣地已创建。

postcondition.success: available=true, postcondition_observed=true, selection_verified=true, actual desired state in captured context; ui_selection_verified additionally needs attempted+invoked
postcondition.already_selected: already_selected_verified plus independently observed desired selected state; no invocation needed
postcondition.unknown: native_dispatch_attempted=true may coexist with dispatch_invoked=false; available=false/status=verification_pending; retain raw receipt and do not automatically resend
postcondition.refused: no attempt, available=false/status=unavailable; preserve diagnostic and any observed context
postcondition.observation_before_retry: query current selected state first; no claim of durable cross-restart deduplication is made
postcondition.context_null: capture was not available; preserve null rather than inventing actor/date/selection
postcondition.binding: nested capture_epoch must equal outer pump_epoch, played actor/date bind to actual current snapshot, current faith must match observed window

boundaries: No create operation, actor override, faith override, arbitrary callback, address or coordinates.
Native bool reports observed state only. A true native button under unknown bypass cannot establish ordinary legality.
Synthetic visibility/GUI addresses/selected states prove serialization and consumer contracts only, not rendered UI or native selection execution.
Existing signed high-bit played actor remains rejected at the public CharacterRef entry; no conversion of original raw actor IDs was introduced.
This candidate uses only exact CK3 1.20.0.4 build identity. No other build or historical machine installation is qualified.
